The '''Com623''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] communications implant manufactured by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]]. [[Howzmin]], the chief of security for [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] [[Xizor's Palace|palace]], had a Com623 implanted in his body.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
